title: 2D Delivery × Retry Disposition Matrix with Stability Sampling

claims.assertion: Agent action results and error envelopes must bifurcate outcomes along two independent dimensions: DeliveryDisposition (NotDelivered, DeliveryUncertain, DeliveredUnverified, DeliveredVerified) and RetryDisposition (Safe, Unsafe, Unknown), preventing destructive double-activation of non-idempotent controls.

distilled_learning: When an agent interacts with a desktop GUI, failure to deliver an action differs crucially from delivering an action without observation verification. agent-desktop pairs DeliveryDisposition with RetryDisposition in every envelope and error. Furthermore, check_with_stability_or_gap samples transient window animations before converting a layout shift into an error, ensuring agent ReAct execution loops know with mathematical certainty whether an action can safely be retried or requires an emergency transaction rollback.
